The successful execution of this ambitious project hinges on the unique synergy and deep, complementary expertise pooled within the Planetary Public Good DAO consortium. Our founding partners collectively possess a proven track record spanning foundational research, practical implementation, large-scale community building, specific Cardano ecosystem navigation, and creative execution, ensuring all facets of the proposal are backed by relevant experience.

(Note: Relevant links providing evidence for the experience described below will be included in Section 6: Further Information of the GovTool submission interface. We encourage reading this narrative overview first to understand the breadth and depth of the consortium's capabilities.)

* DOB Protocol (Core R&D Lead - AI, DAM, DePIN):

1. Validated DePIN Market Application: Possesses significant real-world validation through its operational Decentralized Physical Infrastructure Network (DePIN) financing platform, active in Chile and Peru since November 2024. This platform has already onboarded major partners (2 Large Development Institutions - LDIs), demonstrating practical expertise in bridging on-chain finance (DeFi) with real-world infrastructure.
2. Pioneering Academic Research (DAMs): Authored the foundational paper "Trustworthy Decentralized Autonomous Machines: A New Paradigm in Automation Economy" (arXiv:2504.15676), which has been accepted to the prestigious IEEE International Workshop on DePIN 2025 (at IEEE ICBC 2025). This provides strong academic validation for the Decentralized Autonomous Machine (DAM) concepts informing the consortium's R&D and aligns perfectly with Cardano's research-driven ethos.
3. Technical Expertise: The team includes individuals with deep expertise in Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), blockchain development, Internet of Things (IoT) integration, and financial modeling, led by experienced entrepreneurs and researchers (including a PhD from TU Berlin). This ensures the capability to develop the sophisticated AGI Agent and explore DAM/DePIN integrations.

* Cooperativa Local (Consortium Lead, Ecosystem Orchestration & DAO Expertise):

1. Proven Cardano DAO Incubation & Acceleration: Successfully designed and executed the 2024 Cardano DAO Incubation Program (supported by Catalyst Fund11), onboarding 8 diverse Chilean cooperatives/unions (including partner IME DAO) onto Cardano DAO platforms (Clarity/Summon). This program achieved 100% participant retention and a 6.85/7 average satisfaction score, validating our methodologies for effective DAO education, onboarding, and support, even amidst varying technical literacy.
2. Extensive Web3 Adoption & Community Building (Since 2021): Backed previously by Start-Up Chile and multiple Cardano Catalyst funds, Cooperativa Local built and operated a multi-chain platform engaging over 1,300 users primarily from Latin America (many first-time Web3 users) generating over 85,000 on-chain/off-chain interactions (crypto wallets, paid 'likes', NFTs, DAO tokens, on-chain polls, decentralized blogging). This demonstrates deep experience in user onboarding, community management, and platform development in the target region.
3. Creative Economy Integration & Phygital Expertise: Curated and produced 9 major physical exhibitions (including three at GAM, Chile's premier cultural center) showcasing over 200 physical/digital artworks and NFTs to over 3,000 attendees. These events involved collaborations with global Web3 entities like NounsDAO and PizzaDAO, proving our ability to bridge Web3 concepts with tangible, high-impact cultural experiences – foundational for the AGI Avatar Phygital Interface.
4. Creative Network & IP Management: Cultivated a network of approximately 300+ artists, creators, cultural workers, and entertainment agents over years of activity. This network is crucial for ethically sourcing and licensing diverse, high-quality creative works to power the unique visual identity of the AGI Avatar Phygital Interface, managed through Cooperativa Local's established processes.

* ChileDAO (National Testbed, Network Hub & Talent Pool):

1. Operational DAO Experience: Actively functions as a Decentralized Autonomous Organization, managing diverse initiatives and community governance (currently leveraging Colony/Arbitrum, with commitment to migrate core functions to Cardano/Clarity).
2. Extensive Ecosystem Building: Successfully building a national Web3 hub in Chile, connecting disparate actors. Experience includes running educational programs and bootcamp such as "Universidad Santiago de Chile", organizing community events, and mapping the national ecosystem.
3. Rich Multi-chain Network: Its membership includes active participants and leaders from across major blockchain ecosystems (Cardano, Ethereum, Polkadot, Avalanche, Stellar, Bitcoin) and key industry organizations (Cámara Blockchain Chile, FinteChile), providing an invaluable source of cross-chain insights, collaboration opportunities, and specialized talent for the consortium.

* IME DAO (Real-World Cultural Application & Showcase):

1. Cardano DAO in Action: Uniquely positioned as a DAO formed from an existing ~200-member trade union, actively using Cardano's Clarity Protocol for its governance and operations. This provides direct, practical experience on the target platform.
2.Complex Project Management: Demonstrating significant organizational capacity by undertaking the production of the IME Link festival (June 2025) – a large-scale, decentralized cultural event involving ~30 artistic performances and ~30 talks. This serves as a powerful, real-world stress test and showcase for the AGI Agent and AGI Avatar Phygital Interface within the demanding creative industries sector.

* Cardano Confederation (and other communities providing Cardano Governance Expertise & Ethical Frameworks):

1. Deep Governance Insight: Comprised of experienced, active Cardano Delegated Representatives (DReps) and governance specialists deeply familiar with Cardano Improvement Proposals (CIPs), on-chain voting mechanics, treasury systems, and community dynamics.
2. Practical Application Testing: Provides a direct avenue to pilot and refine AGI Agent tools specifically designed to assist DReps and potentially Intersect committees (e.g., information synthesis, proposal tracking, sentiment analysis), ensuring relevance to Cardano's core governance needs.
3. Audit Oversight: Their principle-based approach ensures the development and deployment of AGI within the consortium adhere to high ethical standards and transparency, crucial for community trust.

* Creative & Visual Expertise (Brauxelion & Network):

1. Collaboration with established Web3 artists like Brauxelion (leading Chilean Cyber-Perreo artist active since 2020), responsible for the AGI Avatar Phygital Interface promotional video, ensures cutting-edge, culturally relevant visual direction. Access to Cooperativa Local's broader network guarantees high-quality creative inputs.

Conclusion: This consortium represents an unparalleled convergence of expertise tailored precisely for this proposal's objectives. We combine Cooperativa Local's proven DAO incubation, community building, and creative network management on Cardano; DOB Protocol's academically validated, market-tested leadership in AI, DAM, and DePIN; ChileDAO's extensive multi-chain network and national coordination experience; IME DAO's real-world Cardano DAO operation in the demanding cultural sector; the Cardano Confederation's and other communities deep governance insight and ethical guidance; and top-tier creative talent. This unique blend provides extremely strong qualifications and significantly de-risks the execution of this ambitious, ecosystem-defining project.

attributes.proposal_description:
1. Lead Entity & Vision: This proposal is presented by the Planetary Public Good Network, a pioneering consortium initiative dedicated to establishing Cardano as the secure, foundational infrastructure for a global network supporting the future of decentralized public goods. Our mission is to facilitate the creation, incubation, and acceleration of impactful public goods worldwide.

* We are building the Planetary Public Good DAO Framework – a synergistic integration of DAO operational methodology, advanced Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) Agents, and the interactive AGI Avatar Phygital Interface.
* This framework is envisioned as the ultimate and first Planetary Public Good delivered by this consortium, aiming to usher in a New Era of intelligent, effective, transparent, and sustainable decentralized organization, powered by real-time AGI insights derived from opt-in governance information provided transparently by participating DAOs (facilitated via DOB Protocol infrastructure). We strive for this framework to become the globally recognized benchmark for all DAOs seeking high performance and impact.

2. Founding Partners & Roles: The DAO launches with a powerhouse consortium of founding partners, each bringing unique expertise and serving as crucial testbeds, committed to collaborating on Cardano's DAO infrastructure (initially Clarity Protocol):

2.1. ChileDAO: ChileDAO: A vibrant, established national Web3 hub acting as a crucial bridge between diverse blockchain ecosystems (Cardano, Bitcoin, Ethereum, Chainlink, Avalanche, Stellar, Polkadot, Internet Computer (ICP), Mantle, Worldcoin, etc), academia and educational institutions, industry (Cámara Blockchain, FinteChile members), and a large community (>30 core members, >400 network). Committed to migrating its operations and onboarding representatives from its 30+ associated projects onto Cardano DAOs, ChileDAO serves as a complex, real-world testbed for AGI managing national-level coordination, ecosystem mapping, and acting as a rich talent pool for the consortium.

2.2. DOB Protocol: A cutting-edge research and development entity focused on the intersection of AI, blockchain, and real-world systems. With an operational Decentralized Physical Infrastructure Network (DePIN) financing platform in Chile and Peru, and published, peer-reviewed research on Decentralized Autonomous Machines (DAMs) (arXiv:2504.15676, IEEE ICBC 2025), DOB Protocol leads the R&D for the consortium's AGI Agent (based on their DOBI agent) and spearheads explorations into applying DAM/DePIN concepts to enhance DAO capabilities for managing Governance Data, Real World Assets (RWA), DeFi Contracts, and critical infrastructure on Cardano.

2.3. Cooperativa Local: A Chilean organization with deep expertise (since 2021) in Web3 adoption, community building within the cultural and creative sectors (backed by Start-Up Chile, Catalyst), and specifically in Cardano DAO incubation/acceleration (proven F11 program). Cooperativa Local provides the essential onboarding framework for all partners onto Cardano DAO platforms, manages the consortium's operations, coordinates the AGI Avatar Phygital Interface Focus Group, manages creative asset licensing, and runs the Planetary Public Good DAO's Public Program for global outreach.

2.4. Cardano Confederation and/or other groups active on governance: promoting principle-based networks comprising experienced of Cardano Community Members and Delegated Representatives (DReps) and active governance participants such as Intersect working groups or Community Hubs. Facilitating governance actions with ethics and transparency, the Confederation and other communities such as Intersect Hubs will provide invaluable insights to our focused on AGI Cardano's governance needs, serving as a pilot group for testing AGI tools designed to enhance DRep efficiency and members' governance (e.g., proposal summarization, sentiment analysis), and ensures the consortium's outputs remain aligned with Cardano's core values and community interests.

2.5. IME DAO: A unique Decentralized Autonomous Organization formed by Chile's union of electronic music workers (~200 members, ~60 active on Cardano/Clarity). Incubated and Accelerated by Cooperativa Local, IME DAO demonstrates the practical application of DAOs in the complex cultural sector by producing Chile's first decentralized music and technology festival, IME Link (June 21-22, 2025, Santiago de Chile). This provides a high-visibility, mass-audience showcase for the AGI Agent and the AGI Avatar Phygital Interface in action.

3. Core Public Good Deliverables: This proposal focuses the consortium's initial efforts on the intensive R&D, refinement, and launch of three core, interconnected Planetary Public Goods:

3.1. The Planetary Public Good DAO Framework (Ultimate & First Public Good): The overarching methodology, best practices, governance templates, and operational models for creating and running effective, AI-enhanced public good DAOs.

3.2. The AGI Agent for DAOs (Second Public Good): The adaptable AI software layer providing contextual intelligence and operational support to DAOs.

3.3. The AGI Avatar Phygital Interface (Third Public Good): The novel, interactive, and sustainable visual front-end for engaging with the AGI Agent and the DAO ecosystem.

4. Multichain Vision, Cardano Core: The framework, AGI Agent support layer, and AGI Avatar Phygital Interface are designed with multichain compatibility in mind (licensable), enabling broad adoption. However, the core Planetary Public Good DAO infrastructure, critical governance data security, core AGI processing logic, and primary value anchoring will remain based on Cardano, leveraging its unparalleled security, research foundation, and governance capabilities.

5. Eligibility & Gov Alignment: This initiative's scale, strategic R&D focus (AGI, DAM, DePIN), ecosystem-building scope, and alignment with Voltaire make it fundamentally suited for the Cardano Budget Process. It addresses needs unmet by Project Catalyst, particularly the lack of suitable funding mechanisms for intensive, tailored R&D support for emerging public good DAOs without large pre-existing revenues.

6. Budget & Treasury: Estimated cost: $370,000 USD (731,080 ADA) @ $0.5061 USD/ADA (S3 Support-3 based on Tradingview technical report of April-24). Funds will be managed with full transparency in the Planetary Public Good DAO's Treasury (Clarity Protocol), including publicly published monthly expenditure reports. Responsible spending is a core principle.

* Quarter 3, 2025 (July - September):

7. Viral Content Package 1: Release of introductory videos explaining the AGI Agent and AGI Avatar Phygital Interface, interviews with founding partners, demonstration snippets of Alfa versions, and blog posts detailing legal consultation progress and initial R&D findings.

Nov '25): Delivery of a compelling virtual or local presentation showcasing Beta AGI Agent progress, refined AGI Avatar Phygital Interface concepts/MVP demo, and the consortium's DAM/DePIN research direction, emphasizing alignment with "Blockchain for Good". (Note: No international travel budget allocated).
12. Beta AGI Avatar Phygital Interface (MVP) & Campaign: Launch of a functional Minimum Viable Product (MVP) of the digital interface with core interaction loops, refined visuals incorporating more licensed assets, basic personalization features, and initial tests of embedded virality mechanics (e.g., generating shareable DAO participation summaries). Includes a targeted social media campaign to gather user feedback on the MVP. Results from early physical display integration tests documented.
13. Interim DAM/DePIN R&D Report Blog Post: Delivery of a comprehensive technical report blog post detailing the governance data layer prototype results and potentially exploring DAM concepts for infrastructure interaction (e.g., theoretical energy monitoring linkage). Submission of findings as a preprint (e.g., arXiv) or to a relevant technical workshop if milestones align.
14. Viral Content Package 2: Release of videos demonstrating Beta AGI Agent features, Tech for Impact presentation recording, AGI Avatar Phygital Interface MVP showcase, R&D updates, partner progress spotlights, and initial findings from virality experiments.
Quarter 1, 2026 (January - March):
15. Product AGI Agent Milestone (Refined Beta / v0.9): Delivery of a significantly refined AGI Agent with improved accuracy, broader DAO task support capabilities, enhanced governance analytics (e.g., trend analysis across proposals), robust APIs for integration, and potentially basic predictive modeling based on DAO activity.
16. Cardano Governance Pilot Analysis Report: Publication of a detailed report, co-authored or validated with the Cardano Confederation and/or other Cardano Communities, analyzing the effectiveness, challenges, and potential of the AGI Agent in supporting DRep workflows, members participations and committee operations based on pilot testing.
17. DAM/DePIN Prototype Validation Report: Delivery of a report detailing the results of tested DAM/DePIN prototypes (e.g., validated energy monitoring linkage, successful structuring of specific governance events as DePIN data), including performance metrics, scalability assessments, and security considerations.
18. Viral Content Package 3: Release of content detailing the governance pilot findings, DAM/DePIN prototype demonstrations, refined AGI Avatar Phygital Interface features, and progress towards the framework launch.

* Quarter 2, 2026 (April - June):

19. Planetary Public Good DAO Framework v1.0 Launch: Public release encompassing:
19.1. Documented DAO operational methodologies and best practices derived from partner experiences.
19.2. AGI Agent for DAOs v1.0: Stable version with core functionalities, APIs, and documentation.
19.3. AGI Avatar Phygital Interface v1.0: Polished version incorporating MVP feedback, refined virality mechanics, initial integration of the sustainability model (e.g., showcase slots), and guidelines for physical deployment.
19.4. Accompanied by a dedicated launch campaign (webinars, tutorials, promotional materials).

20. Major Showcase @ IME Fest 2026: Deployment of a significant, interactive installation featuring the AGI Avatar Phygital Interface v1.0 on large-scale LED screens and/or holographic displays, live AGI Agent demonstrations tailored to the event context, workshops on the Framework.
21. Open Program Launch: Official launch of the Planetary Public Good DAO's public program, including an application portal, defined curriculum/support structure based on the Framework, and onboarding of the first global cohort/users interested in creating or enhancing public good DAOs with AGI support.
22. Final DAM/DePIN R&D Report: Blog post of the comprehensive final research report detailing all findings, based on the R&D conducted throughout the project.
23. Comprehensive Project Documentation & Case Studies: Public release of a detailed knowledge base (e.g., GitBook, dedicated website) containing all process documentation, partner case studies (IME DAO, ChileDAO, Confederation and other Cardano Communities), technical specifications, user guides, ethical guidelines (esp. for AI/licensed content), and lessons learned.

attributes.problem_statement:
This proposal directly confronts a critical constellation of interconnected problems hindering the realization of Cardano's potential as a global platform for decentralized collaboration, governance, and real-world impact. Despite the promise of Decentralized Autonomous Organizations (DAOs), their widespread adoption and effectiveness are significantly hampered by fundamental challenges:

1. Prohibitive DAO Complexity & Usability Barriers: Launching, managing, and participating effectively in DAOs remains excessively complex for the vast majority of potential users and organizations.

1.1. Steep Learning Curve: Onboarding requires significant technical literacy and time investment to understand governance mechanics, token interactions, and platform tools. This was a key challenge identified in Cooperativa Local's 2024 Cardano DAO Incubator, limiting participation primarily to technically adept individuals.

1.2. Operational Inefficiency: DAOs struggle with coordinating tasks, managing diverse communication channels (Discord, forums, etc.), tracking contributions fairly, and executing decisions efficiently without centralized overhead or sophisticated tooling.

1.3. Information Overload: As DAOs scale, members (and representatives like Cardano's DReps) face an overwhelming volume of proposals, discussions, and data, making informed participation and effective governance extremely difficult.

1.4. Unengaging Interfaces: Current DAO interaction primarily relies on functional but often unintuitive dashboards and text-based chat interfaces. These fail to capture the engagement of diverse users, especially those from creative or non-technical backgrounds, and lack the capacity for nuanced, context-aware interaction.

2. Ecosystem Fragmentation and Siloed Collaboration: The broader blockchain space, including Cardano's ecosystem, often operates in silos. National communities (like the diverse Web3 scene in Chile before ChileDAO's efforts) lack unified platforms for collaboration, leading to duplicated efforts and missed opportunities. This fragmentation extends globally, preventing synergistic development and knowledge sharing between regional hubs or different blockchain communities.

3. Difficulty Demonstrating Tangible Real-World Value: Communicating the practical benefits and transformative potential of blockchain and DAOs beyond niche Decentralized Finance (DeFi) applications remains a major hurdle. It is difficult to showcase compelling, relatable use cases that resonate with mainstream audiences, businesses, and traditional institutions, limiting broader adoption and understanding of Cardano's capabilities. Projects like IME DAO's ambitious decentralized festival face challenges in articulating their innovative model effectively.

4. The AI Integration Gap in Governance: While Artificial Intelligence (AI) holds immense potential to augment DAO capabilities, its integration into governance and operations is nascent and largely theoretical. There's a lack of:

4.1. Practical Frameworks: Methodologies for safely and effectively embedding AI into DAO decision-making loops are underdeveloped.

4.2. Tailored AI Tools: Generic AI models lack the specific contextual understanding of individual DAO goals, history, culture, and operational needs required for truly useful assistance.

4.3. Ethical Considerations: Frameworks for ensuring AI use in DAOs is transparent, accountable, and aligned with community values are missing.

5. Bridging Advanced Concepts (DAM/DePIN) to Practice: Cutting-edge concepts like Decentralized Autonomous Machines (DAMs) – AI-driven entities managing real-world assets via Internet of Things (IoT) and blockchain – and Decentralized Physical Infrastructure Networks (DePIN) offer powerful future possibilities. However, translating this academic research (like DOB Protocol's foundational paper) into practical applications within DAOs requires dedicated R&D, integration pathways, and real-world testbeds, which are currently scarce. DAOs lack the tools to easily interact with or govern RWA or DePIN infrastructure.

6. Funding & Sustainability Mismatch for Public Goods: Emerging DAOs focused on public goods, cultural initiatives (like IME DAO), or national ecosystem building (like ChileDAO) often lack substantial revenue streams. They require intensive, bespoke R&D support (e.g., for customized AI integration) that doesn't fit neatly into traditional venture capital or product-focused grant programs like Project Catalyst's recent partner challenges, creating a critical funding gap for foundational ecosystem development. Furthermore, sustainable operational models for such DAOs are needed beyond initial grants.

7. Scalability Challenges in Decentralized Governance (incl. Cardano's): As decentralized networks grow, ensuring effective, scalable governance becomes paramount. Cardano's own system, while pioneering, faces challenges related to DRep engagement, information processing for informed voting, and efficient coordination across committees and working groups. There is a need for innovative tools and potentially new models to support the Voltaire era's goals.

8. Regional Underrepresentation & Lack of Tailored Support: Key regions like Latin America and Africa, despite significant user interest and potential, remain underrepresented in Cardano governance metrics with less than 5% of de dRep voting power based on tenpo.vote reports / and may lack ecosystem support initiatives tailored to their specific cultural, linguistic, and economic contexts.

In essence, this proposal seeks to address the critical gap between the immense theoretical potential of AI-enhanced DAOs on Cardano for managing public goods, RWA, and complex systems, and the practical realities of usability, coordination, funding, and demonstrating value that currently limit their impact. We aim to solve these interconnected problems by building the foundational framework, intelligent tools (AGI Agent), engaging interfaces (AGI Avatar Phygital Interface), and validated, high-visibility use cases necessary to unlock this potential.

The implementation of the Planetary Public Good DAO & AGI Agents proposal will deliver multifaceted benefits across the entire Cardano ecosystem, providing substantial and demonstrable value. This initiative moves beyond incremental improvements to deliver foundational infrastructure and showcase Cardano's unique capabilities in intelligent decentralized governance, ultimately yielding significant strategic, technological, and economic ROI for the community.

1.1. Benefit: The primary output is the Planetary Public Good DAO Framework, encompassing the methodology, the AGI Agent for DAOs (Second Public Good), and the AGI Avatar Phygital Interface (Third Public Good). Attracting high-quality projects seeking superior DAO infrastructure enhances Cardano's network effect and reputation. It provides context-aware intelligence tailored to each DAO's specific goals and operational data (sourced transparently via opt-in mechanisms, potentially using DOB Protocol's infrastructure). This translates to streamlined onboarding, intelligent summarization of complex governance discussions, data-driven insights for decision-making, proactive task management suggestions, and overall increased operational efficiency.

ROI can be measured via DAO activity metrics (proposal throughput, voting times, task completion rates), member satisfaction surveys, qualitative feedback from the Confederation pilot, and observed reductions in governance friction.

3.1. Benefit: The AGI Avatar Phygital Interface delivers a unique, highly engaging, and accessible way for humans to interact with DAOs and the underlying AGI Agent. Moving beyond text-based chats, it offers a visual, potentially voice-driven, culturally-attuned experience deployable ubiquitously – on mobile devices, large event displays (LEDs/holograms), and potentially in public phygital installations. It serves as a powerful onboarding tool, guiding newcomers through Cardano and DAO concepts. Critically, it incorporates a sustainable model for network promotion and advertising, ensuring its long-term viability as a public good. Its integration with DePIN allows contextual AGI responsiveness, adapting to its environment.

3.2. Target Community: Benefits newcomers to Cardano and DAOs (lowering entry barriers), non-technical users, existing DAO members (more engaging interaction), event attendees (memorable experiences), the general public (increased visibility of Cardano), artists/creators (ethical licensing model via Cooperativa Local), and Cardano marketing/community teams (powerful engagement and education platform).

3.3. Value/ROI: Expected to dramatically increase onboarding success rates and user retention within the Cardano ecosystem. Generates significant viral marketing potential through shareable interactions and visually stunning event displays, boosting Cardano's brand awareness and appeal. The sustainable model provides ongoing funding for ecosystem promotion. The R&D into its potential function as a Cardano node offers ROI in network decentralization. ROI measured by user adoption metrics, social media engagement analytics (reach, shares, sentiment), conversion rates from interaction to participation, event feedback, and eventually, revenue generated by the interface network itself.

4. Validated High-Impact Use Cases & Ecosystem Growth:

4.1. Benefit: The consortium structure ensures the framework is not developed in isolation but validated through deep implementation within diverse, high-impact founding partners: IME DAO (revolutionizing cultural event production with its decentralized festival), ChileDAO (creating a model for national Web3 coordination on Cardano), and Cardano Confederation and other active groups on governance (enhancing Cardano improvement iterations). The launch of the Open Program in Q2 2026 provides a scalable mechanism for onboarding unlimited new DAOs globally.

4.2. Target Community: Benefits the entire Cardano ecosystem by providing concrete, compelling proof points of the platform's utility. Attracts potential enterprise, institutional, and governmental adopters seeking validated decentralized solutions. Directly supports specific sectors (culture, national coordination, governance) and underrepresented regions (Latam), while establishing a strategic foothold in Japan.

4.3. Value/ROI: Shifts Cardano's narrative from potential to proven capability. Generates high-quality case studies and testimonials. Strengthens specific regional ecosystems, potentially leading to increased local adoption and development activity. The Open Program directly drives network growth by onboarding new DAOs and users. ROI measured by partner success metrics (e.g., IME Link attendance/impact, ChileDAO project milestones), media coverage, new enterprise/institutional inquiries, adoption rate of the Open Program, and growth in targeted geographic regions.

5. Cutting-Edge R&D, Knowledge Contribution & Academic Alignment:

5.1. Benefit: This proposal includes a significant R&D component led by DOB Protocol, building directly upon their peer-reviewed DAM research (arXiv:2504.15676). It explores the practical application of DAMs and DePIN concepts within the context of public good DAOs on Cardano, investigating governance data layers and infrastructure interaction. Findings are explicitly planned for scientific publication and broad community dissemination, contributing valuable knowledge assets.

5.2. Target Community: Benefits Cardano's research community (IOHK, Foundation, university partners), developers, technical architects, and the broader academic world. Also benefits SPOs and infrastructure providers if the R&D on Interfaces as Nodes proves fruitful. Strengthens Cardano's strategic positioning as a platform built on rigorous research and capable of supporting next-generation autonomous systems.

5.3. Value/ROI: Enhances Cardano's global reputation for technological leadership and rigorous innovation. Attracts top-tier research talent and R&D-focused projects. Published research and open frameworks serve as invaluable public goods, potentially informing future protocol upgrades (CIPs) or inspiring new dApps. ROI measured by the quality and impact of research outputs (publications, citations), contributions to technical standards, attraction of new research collaborations, and long-term influence on Cardano's technical direction.

6. Increased & Diversified On-Chain Activity & DeFi Potential:

6.1. Benefit: The proliferation of effective, active, AI-enhanced DAOs naturally drives diverse on-chain activity on Cardano platforms like Clarity (governance votes, proposals, treasury actions). Furthermore, the integration with DOB Protocol's DePIN financing platform and the exploration of DAMs managing RWA/infrastructure introduce significant new vectors for on-chain transactions related to real-world economic activity. This robust DAO infrastructure enables more sophisticated and trustworthy DeFi applications, such as large liquidity pools (e.g., ADA/BTC) governed directly by intelligent DAOs.

6.2. Target Community: Directly benefits Stake Pool Operators (SPOs) through increased network load and transaction fees. Benefits ADA holders through potentially increased network utility and value. ROI measurable via core on-chain metrics (transaction counts, active addresses, TVL), DeFi protocol adoption statistics, and SPO profitability trends.

* Conclusion: The demonstrated value and ROI for the Cardano community are comprehensive and substantial. This proposal delivers not just tools, but a foundational framework for a new era of intelligent decentralized organization (the Planetary Public Good DAO Framework). It enhances Cardano's technological capabilities (AGI, DAM/DePIN R&D), dramatically improves user experience and onboarding (AGI Avatar Phygital Interface), fosters significant ecosystem growth through high-impact use cases and an Open Program, increases network activity and DeFi potential, and reinforces Cardano's position as a global leader in research-driven blockchain innovation. * The following breakdown details the allocation of funds across the consortium's key activity areas. Payments will be disbursed upon successful completion and verification of pre-agreed milestones associated with these activities. All expenditures will be managed transparently through the Planetary Public Good Network DAO's treasury on Clarity Protocol, requiring DAO approval via multi-signature processes for disbursements, with detailed monthly financial reports made publicly available.

 DOB Protocol: AGI Agent & DAM/DePIN R&D:
* $70,000 USD 
* Purpose: Covers the core research and development led by DOB Protocol for the Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) Agent and related advanced concepts.
Activities Included:
1. Development of the AGI Agent core logic, algorithms, and integration APIs (covering Alfa, Beta, v1.0 milestones).
2. Dedicated research into applying Decentralized Autonomous Machine (DAM) principles and Decentralized Physical Infrastructure Network (DePIN) concepts for managing DAO governance data layers and potential public good infrastructure interactions on Cardano.
3. Preparation of technical documentation and research findings for community dissemination.
4. Associated personnel costs for DOB Protocol's dedicated AI researchers and blockchain developers involved in this stream.

Partner DAO AGI Use Case Development & Support:
* $55,000 USD
* Purpose: Funds the direct collaboration with founding partners to tailor and implement the AGI Agent framework for their specific needs.
Activities Included:
1. Deployment, configuration, and fine-tuning of AGI Agent instances for ChileDAO (national coordination), IME DAO (cultural event management support), and Cardano Confederation and/or other active Cardano communities (for governance enhancement pilot).
2. Development and delivery of onboarding materials and training sessions for partner DAOs to effectively utilize the AGI Agent and associated tools.
3. Facilitation of co-design workshops with each partner to define specific AGI functionalities, Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), and success metrics for their use cases.
4. Ongoing technical support and troubleshooting for partner DAOs during the pilot and implementation phases.
5. Associated personnel costs for consortium DAO specialists and technical liaisons facilitating partner integration.

 AGI Avatar Phygital Interface (Dev, R&D, Licensing, Displays):
* $70,000 USD 
* Purpose: Covers the comprehensive design, development, and R&D for the innovative AGI Avatar Phygital Interface public good.
Activities Included:
1. User Experience (UX) / User Interface (UI) design iterations (Alfa, Beta, v1.0) incorporating feedback from the AGI Avatar Focus Group (Incubator alumni).
2. Frontend development for web and potentially mobile interaction layers.
3. Management of intellectual property (IP) and securing licenses for the curated library of creative works (via Cooperativa Local) used in the interface's visuals.
4. Dedicated R&D into engagement mechanics and social media virality optimisation.
5. R&D and prototyping for physical display integrations (LED screens, holographic displays) and necessary hardware/software interfacing.
6. Integration with the AGI Agent backend and DePIN data layers for contextual responsiveness.
7. Associated personnel costs (Designers, developers, IP manager, marketing analyst).

 Planetary Public Good Network - Core Ops, Legal & Open Program:
* $40,000 USD 
* Purpose: Covers the operational backbone of the consortium DAO and the launch of its public-facing program.
Activities Included:
1. Overall consortium coordination, project management, and administrative overhead.
2. Initial legal consultation and fees associated with establishing the optimal legal structure (Japan DAO LLC vs. Chile Foundation).
3. Setup and maintenance of the central Planetary Public Good DAO infrastructure on Clarity Protocol and associated communication channels.
4. Development and launch (Q2 2026) of the public "Open Program" platform, including onboarding materials and resources for new DAOs joining the network.
5. Associated core operational personnel/admin costs.

 Showcasing, Content & R&D Dissemination:
* $75,000 USD 
* Purpose: Ensures broad visibility, effective communication of progress and learnings, and dissemination of research findings.
Activities Included:
1. Logistical support and content preparation for showcasing at key events (IME Link [retroactive content capture], Chile Blockchain Week, Devconnect, Tech for Impact Summit [virtual/local presence], IME Fest 2026).
2. Production of high-quality, engaging content: viral videos, comprehensive case studies (IME DAO, ChileDAO), detailed process documentation, tutorials, articles.
3. Management of global marketing and communications campaigns across multiple channels.
4. Support for formatting and disseminating R&D findings (reports, blog posts.
5. Associated personnel costs (content creators, marketers, event coordinators) and vendor fees (e.g., video production).

 Compliance, Security & Contingency:
* $25,000 USD 
* Purpose: Ensures operational robustness, financial integrity, and adaptability.
Activities Included:
1. Ongoing legal review for multi-jurisdictional compliance (DAO regulations, AI ethics, IP, data privacy).
2. Financial administration support and potential independent auditing costs.
3. Treasury Security: Implementation and rigorous maintenance of secure fund management protocols, primarily using Clarity Protocol's multi-signature wallet capabilities, requiring pre-defined DAO voting thresholds and processes for authorizing any expenditure.
4. Contingency buffer (approx. 8% of total budget) allocated for unforeseen technical challenges, market shifts, or necessary scope adjustments during the R&D and implementation phases.

Expert Advisory Services:
* $35,000 USD 
* Purpose: Dedicated fund to engage world-class external expertise, ensuring best practices and cutting-edge insights inform the project.
Activities Included: Retaining advisors (short-term contracts/consultancy fees) as needed across all project areas (e.g., AI ethics, DAM/DePIN protocols, advanced UX/HCI for the Avatar Interface, DAO governance models, viral marketing techniques, international legal structuring, specialized technical challenges). Allocation accessed proportionally by different project streams based on need, with expenditures approved transparently via the DAO treasury vote.

The successful execution of this ambitious project hinges on the unique synergy and deep, complementary expertise pooled within the Planetary Public Good DAO consortium. Our founding partners collectively possess a proven track record spanning foundational research, practical implementation, large-scale community building, specific Cardano ecosystem navigation, and creative execution, ensuring all facets of the proposal are backed by relevant experience.

(Note: Relevant links providing evidence for the experience described below will be included in Section 6: Further Information of the GovTool submission interface. We encourage reading this narrative overview first to understand the breadth and depth of the consortium's capabilities.)

* DOB Protocol (Core R&D Lead - AI, DAM, DePIN):

1. Validated DePIN Market Application: Possesses significant real-world validation through its operational Decentralized Physical Infrastructure Network (DePIN) financing platform, active in Chile and Peru since November 2024. This platform has already onboarded major partners (2 Large Development Institutions - LDIs), demonstrating practical expertise in bridging on-chain finance (DeFi) with real-world infrastructure.
2. Pioneering Academic Research (DAMs): Authored the foundational paper "Trustworthy Decentralized Autonomous Machines: A New Paradigm in Automation Economy" (arXiv:2504.15676), which has been accepted to the prestigious IEEE International Workshop on DePIN 2025 (at IEEE ICBC 2025). This provides strong academic validation for the Decentralized Autonomous Machine (DAM) concepts informing the consortium's R&D and aligns perfectly with Cardano's research-driven ethos.
3. Technical Expertise: The team includes individuals with deep expertise in Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), blockchain development, Internet of Things (IoT) integration, and financial modeling, led by experienced entrepreneurs and researchers (including a PhD from TU Berlin). This ensures the capability to develop the sophisticated AGI Agent and explore DAM/DePIN integrations.

* Cooperativa Local (Consortium Lead, Ecosystem Orchestration & DAO Expertise):

1. Proven Cardano DAO Incubation & Acceleration: Successfully designed and executed the 2024 Cardano DAO Incubation Program (supported by Catalyst Fund11), onboarding 8 diverse Chilean cooperatives/unions (including partner IME DAO) onto Cardano DAO platforms (Clarity/Summon). This program achieved 100% participant retention and a 6.85/7 average satisfaction score, validating our methodologies for effective DAO education, onboarding, and support, even amidst varying technical literacy.
2. Extensive Web3 Adoption & Community Building (Since 2021): Backed previously by Start-Up Chile and multiple Cardano Catalyst funds, Cooperativa Local built and operated a multi-chain platform engaging over 1,300 users primarily from Latin America (many first-time Web3 users) generating over 85,000 on-chain/off-chain interactions (crypto wallets, paid 'likes', NFTs, DAO tokens, on-chain polls, decentralized blogging). This demonstrates deep experience in user onboarding, community management, and platform development in the target region.
3. Creative Economy Integration & Phygital Expertise: Curated and produced 9 major physical exhibitions (including three at GAM, Chile's premier cultural center) showcasing over 200 physical/digital artworks and NFTs to over 3,000 attendees. These events involved collaborations with global Web3 entities like NounsDAO and PizzaDAO, proving our ability to bridge Web3 concepts with tangible, high-impact cultural experiences – foundational for the AGI Avatar Phygital Interface.
4. Creative Network & IP Management: Cultivated a network of approximately 300+ artists, creators, cultural workers, and entertainment agents over years of activity. This network is crucial for ethically sourcing and licensing diverse, high-quality creative works to power the unique visual identity of the AGI Avatar Phygital Interface, managed through Cooperativa Local's established processes.

* ChileDAO (National Testbed, Network Hub & Talent Pool):

1. Operational DAO Experience: Actively functions as a Decentralized Autonomous Organization, managing diverse initiatives and community governance (currently leveraging Colony/Arbitrum, with commitment to migrate core functions to Cardano/Clarity).
2. Extensive Ecosystem Building: Successfully building a national Web3 hub in Chile, connecting disparate actors. Experience includes running educational programs and bootcamp such as "Universidad Santiago de Chile", organizing community events, and mapping the national ecosystem.
3. Rich Multi-chain Network: Its membership includes active participants and leaders from across major blockchain ecosystems (Cardano, Ethereum, Polkadot, Avalanche, Stellar, Bitcoin) and key industry organizations (Cámara Blockchain Chile, FinteChile), providing an invaluable source of cross-chain insights, collaboration opportunities, and specialized talent for the consortium.

* IME DAO (Real-World Cultural Application & Showcase):

1. Cardano DAO in Action: Uniquely positioned as a DAO formed from an existing ~200-member trade union, actively using Cardano's Clarity Protocol for its governance and operations. This provides direct, practical experience on the target platform.
2.Complex Project Management: Demonstrating significant organizational capacity by undertaking the production of the IME Link festival (June 2025) – a large-scale, decentralized cultural event involving ~30 artistic performances and ~30 talks. This serves as a powerful, real-world stress test and showcase for the AGI Agent and AGI Avatar Phygital Interface within the demanding creative industries sector.

* Cardano Confederation (and other communities providing Cardano Governance Expertise & Ethical Frameworks):

1. Deep Governance Insight: Comprised of experienced, active Cardano Delegated Representatives (DReps) and governance specialists deeply familiar with Cardano Improvement Proposals (CIPs), on-chain voting mechanics, treasury systems, and community dynamics.
2. Practical Application Testing: Provides a direct avenue to pilot and refine AGI Agent tools specifically designed to assist DReps and potentially Intersect committees (e.g., information synthesis, proposal tracking, sentiment analysis), ensuring relevance to Cardano's core governance needs.
3. Audit Oversight: Their principle-based approach ensures the development and deployment of AGI within the consortium adhere to high ethical standards and transparency, crucial for community trust.

* Creative & Visual Expertise (Brauxelion & Network):

1. Collaboration with established Web3 artists like Brauxelion (leading Chilean Cyber-Perreo artist active since 2020), responsible for the AGI Avatar Phygital Interface promotional video, ensures cutting-edge, culturally relevant visual direction. Access to Cooperativa Local's broader network guarantees high-quality creative inputs.

Conclusion: This consortium represents an unparalleled convergence of expertise tailored precisely for this proposal's objectives. We combine Cooperativa Local's proven DAO incubation, community building, and creative network management on Cardano; DOB Protocol's academically validated, market-tested leadership in AI, DAM, and DePIN; ChileDAO's extensive multi-chain network and national coordination experience; IME DAO's real-world Cardano DAO operation in the demanding cultural sector; the Cardano Confederation's and other communities deep governance insight and ethical guidance; and top-tier creative talent. This unique blend provides extremely strong qualifications and significantly de-risks the execution of this ambitious, ecosystem-defining project.

attributes.proposal_description:
1. Lead Entity & Vision: This proposal is presented by the Planetary Public Good Network, a pioneering consortium initiative dedicated to establishing Cardano as the secure, foundational infrastructure for a global network supporting the future of decentralized public goods. Our mission is to facilitate the creation, incubation, and acceleration of impactful public goods worldwide.

* We are building the Planetary Public Good DAO Framework – a synergistic integration of DAO operational methodology, advanced Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) Agents, and the interactive AGI Avatar Phygital Interface.
* This framework is envisioned as the ultimate and first Planetary Public Good delivered by this consortium, aiming to usher in a New Era of intelligent, effective, transparent, and sustainable decentralized organization, powered by real-time AGI insights derived from opt-in governance information provided transparently by participating DAOs (facilitated via DOB Protocol infrastructure). We strive for this framework to become the globally recognized benchmark for all DAOs seeking high performance and impact.

2. Founding Partners & Roles: The DAO launches with a powerhouse consortium of founding partners, each bringing unique expertise and serving as crucial testbeds, committed to collaborating on Cardano's DAO infrastructure (initially Clarity Protocol):

2.1. ChileDAO: ChileDAO: A vibrant, established national Web3 hub acting as a crucial bridge between diverse blockchain ecosystems (Cardano, Bitcoin, Ethereum, Chainlink, Avalanche, Stellar, Polkadot, Internet Computer (ICP), Mantle, Worldcoin, etc), academia and educational institutions, industry (Cámara Blockchain, FinteChile members), and a large community (>30 core members, >400 network). Committed to migrating its operations and onboarding representatives from its 30+ associated projects onto Cardano DAOs, ChileDAO serves as a complex, real-world testbed for AGI managing national-level coordination, ecosystem mapping, and acting as a rich talent pool for the consortium.

2.2. DOB Protocol: A cutting-edge research and development entity focused on the intersection of AI, blockchain, and real-world systems. With an operational Decentralized Physical Infrastructure Network (DePIN) financing platform in Chile and Peru, and published, peer-reviewed research on Decentralized Autonomous Machines (DAMs) (arXiv:2504.15676, IEEE ICBC 2025), DOB Protocol leads the R&D for the consortium's AGI Agent (based on their DOBI agent) and spearheads explorations into applying DAM/DePIN concepts to enhance DAO capabilities for managing Governance Data, Real World Assets (RWA), DeFi Contracts, and critical infrastructure on Cardano.

2.3. Cooperativa Local: A Chilean organization with deep expertise (since 2021) in Web3 adoption, community building within the cultural and creative sectors (backed by Start-Up Chile, Catalyst), and specifically in Cardano DAO incubation/acceleration (proven F11 program). Cooperativa Local provides the essential onboarding framework for all partners onto Cardano DAO platforms, manages the consortium's operations, coordinates the AGI Avatar Phygital Interface Focus Group, manages creative asset licensing, and runs the Planetary Public Good DAO's Public Program for global outreach.

2.4. Cardano Confederation and/or other groups active on governance: promoting principle-based networks comprising experienced of Cardano Community Members and Delegated Representatives (DReps) and active governance participants such as Intersect working groups or Community Hubs. Facilitating governance actions with ethics and transparency, the Confederation and other communities such as Intersect Hubs will provide invaluable insights to our focused on AGI Cardano's governance needs, serving as a pilot group for testing AGI tools designed to enhance DRep efficiency and members' governance (e.g., proposal summarization, sentiment analysis), and ensures the consortium's outputs remain aligned with Cardano's core values and community interests.

2.5. IME DAO: A unique Decentralized Autonomous Organization formed by Chile's union of electronic music workers (~200 members, ~60 active on Cardano/Clarity). Incubated and Accelerated by Cooperativa Local, IME DAO demonstrates the practical application of DAOs in the complex cultural sector by producing Chile's first decentralized music and technology festival, IME Link (June 21-22, 2025, Santiago de Chile). This provides a high-visibility, mass-audience showcase for the AGI Agent and the AGI Avatar Phygital Interface in action.

3. Core Public Good Deliverables: This proposal focuses the consortium's initial efforts on the intensive R&D, refinement, and launch of three core, interconnected Planetary Public Goods:

3.1. The Planetary Public Good DAO Framework (Ultimate & First Public Good): The overarching methodology, best practices, governance templates, and operational models for creating and running effective, AI-enhanced public good DAOs.

3.2. The AGI Agent for DAOs (Second Public Good): The adaptable AI software layer providing contextual intelligence and operational support to DAOs.

3.3. The AGI Avatar Phygital Interface (Third Public Good): The novel, interactive, and sustainable visual front-end for engaging with the AGI Agent and the DAO ecosystem.

4. Multichain Vision, Cardano Core: The framework, AGI Agent support layer, and AGI Avatar Phygital Interface are designed with multichain compatibility in mind (licensable), enabling broad adoption. However, the core Planetary Public Good DAO infrastructure, critical governance data security, core AGI processing logic, and primary value anchoring will remain based on Cardano, leveraging its unparalleled security, research foundation, and governance capabilities.

5. Eligibility & Gov Alignment: This initiative's scale, strategic R&D focus (AGI, DAM, DePIN), ecosystem-building scope, and alignment with Voltaire make it fundamentally suited for the Cardano Budget Process. It addresses needs unmet by Project Catalyst, particularly the lack of suitable funding mechanisms for intensive, tailored R&D support for emerging public good DAOs without large pre-existing revenues.

6. Budget & Treasury: Estimated cost: $370,000 USD (731,080 ADA) @ $0.5061 USD/ADA (S3 Support-3 based on Tradingview technical report of April-24). Funds will be managed with full transparency in the Planetary Public Good DAO's Treasury (Clarity Protocol), including publicly published monthly expenditure reports. Responsible spending is a core principle.

This 12-month initiative (Q3 2025 - Q2 2026), building on foundational work in Q2 2025, is structured around delivering concrete outcomes through iterative development, rigorous testing with founding partners, and continuous knowledge sharing. The community will receive not just final products, but also valuable insights, documented processes, and validated use cases at each stage.

* Current Period (Q2 2025)

1. IME Link Showcase Documentation & Content Baseline: Production and compilation of high-quality video assets, interviews, user feedback, and initial performance metrics from the IME Link festival (June 21-22). This serves as the first major documented use case and provides baseline data for AGI analysis.
2. Initial AGI Avatar Phygital Interface Design Concepts: Development of detailed conceptual designs, user flow diagrams, mood boards, and preliminary UI/UX mockups for the interface, based on intensive design workshops conducted with the AGI Avatar Focus Group (Incubator Alumni). Documentation outlining the ethical framework for using licensed creative assets.
3. PPG Consortium & Viral Campaign Launch: Establishment of official communication channels (website, social media), publication of the consortium's vision and manifesto, initial branding deployment (visuals by Brauxelion), and launch of the overarching viral marketing campaign to build awareness within the Cardano and broader Web3 communities.
* Quarter 3, 2025 (July - September):
4. Legal Structure Recommendation: Delivery of a formal report outlining recommended legal structures (e.g., DAO LLC in Japan vs. Foundation in Chile) for the Planetary Public Good DAO, based on expert consultation considering international operations and compliance.
5. Alfa AGI Agent Deployment & Testing: Deployment of the initial AGI Agent version with core functionalities. Specific tests include:
5.1. ChileDAO: Testing automated onboarding sequences for new members and basic cross-initiative keyword tracking/summarization.
5.2. Cardano Confederation and/or other communities active on governance: Testing basic proposal text summarization and sentiment analysis features with governance participants.
5.3. IME DAO: Applying Alfa Agent to analyze documented data/feedback from the IME Link festival for pattern identification (post-event analysis prototype).
6. Alfa AGI Avatar Phygital Interface Prototype: Development and internal testing of an interactive digital prototype showcasing core interaction loops, initial visual themes using licensed assets, and basic connection to Alfa AGI Agent data. Commencement of R&D into physical display integration (e.g., proof-of-concept screen demo).
7. Viral Content Package 1: Release of introductory videos explaining the AGI Agent and AGI Avatar Phygital Interface, interviews with founding partners, demonstration snippets of Alfa versions, and blog posts detailing legal consultation progress and initial R&D findings.

* Quarter 4, 2025 (October - December):

8. Ecosystem Showcases (Chile Blockchain Week & Devconnect Argentina): Delivery of presentations and live demonstrations showcasing the Alfa AGI Agent functionalities and the Alfa AGI Avatar Phygital Interface concepts and prototypes to the regional Web3 community. Gathering initial feedback.
9. Initial DAM/DePIN R&D Findings: Publication of a detailed blog post or report outlining the proposed architecture for utilizing DePIN principles for a DAO governance data layer, including identified challenges and proposed solutions for data aggregation across platforms (e.g., Clarity, Discord).
10. Beta AGI Agent Deployment & Testing: Deployment of an enhanced AGI Agent with expanded feature sets, including: improved natural language understanding, cross-DAO data correlation (anonymized/permissioned), basic task delegation suggestions, preliminary multi-lingual support tested within Latam context simulations, and initial integration points for DOB Protocol's DePIN data concepts.
11. Tech for Impact Summit Showcase (Japan, est. Nov '25): Delivery of a compelling virtual or local presentation showcasing Beta AGI Agent progress, refined AGI Avatar Phygital Interface concepts/MVP demo, and the consortium's DAM/DePIN research direction, emphasizing alignment with "Blockchain for Good". (Note: No international travel budget allocated).
12. Beta AGI Avatar Phygital Interface (MVP) & Campaign: Launch of a functional Minimum Viable Product (MVP) of the digital interface with core interaction loops, refined visuals incorporating more licensed assets, basic personalization features, and initial tests of embedded virality mechanics (e.g., generating shareable DAO participation summaries). Includes a targeted social media campaign to gather user feedback on the MVP. Results from early physical display integration tests documented.
13. Interim DAM/DePIN R&D Report Blog Post: Delivery of a comprehensive technical report blog post detailing the governance data layer prototype results and potentially exploring DAM concepts for infrastructure interaction (e.g., theoretical energy monitoring linkage). Submission of findings as a preprint (e.g., arXiv) or to a relevant technical workshop if milestones align.
14. Viral Content Package 2: Release of videos demonstrating Beta AGI Agent features, Tech for Impact presentation recording, AGI Avatar Phygital Interface MVP showcase, R&D updates, partner progress spotlights, and initial findings from virality experiments.
Quarter 1, 2026 (January - March):
15. Product AGI Agent Milestone (Refined Beta / v0.9): Delivery of a significantly refined AGI Agent with improved accuracy, broader DAO task support capabilities, enhanced governance analytics (e.g., trend analysis across proposals), robust APIs for integration, and potentially basic predictive modeling based on DAO activity.
16. Cardano Governance Pilot Analysis Report: Publication of a detailed report, co-authored or validated with the Cardano Confederation and/or other Cardano Communities, analyzing the effectiveness, challenges, and potential of the AGI Agent in supporting DRep workflows, members participations and committee operations based on pilot testing.
17. DAM/DePIN Prototype Validation Report: Delivery of a report detailing the results of tested DAM/DePIN prototypes (e.g., validated energy monitoring linkage, successful structuring of specific governance events as DePIN data), including performance metrics, scalability assessments, and security considerations.
18. Viral Content Package 3: Release of content detailing the governance pilot findings, DAM/DePIN prototype demonstrations, refined AGI Avatar Phygital Interface features, and progress towards the framework launch.

* Quarter 2, 2026 (April - June):

19. Planetary Public Good DAO Framework v1.0 Launch: Public release encompassing:
19.1. Documented DAO operational methodologies and best practices derived from partner experiences.
19.2. AGI Agent for DAOs v1.0: Stable version with core functionalities, APIs, and documentation.
19.3. AGI Avatar Phygital Interface v1.0: Polished version incorporating MVP feedback, refined virality mechanics, initial integration of the sustainability model (e.g., showcase slots), and guidelines for physical deployment.
19.4. Accompanied by a dedicated launch campaign (webinars, tutorials, promotional materials).

20. Major Showcase @ IME Fest 2026: Deployment of a significant, interactive installation featuring the AGI Avatar Phygital Interface v1.0 on large-scale LED screens and/or holographic displays, live AGI Agent demonstrations tailored to the event context, workshops on the Framework.
21. Open Program Launch: Official launch of the Planetary Public Good DAO's public program, including an application portal, defined curriculum/support structure based on the Framework, and onboarding of the first global cohort/users interested in creating or enhancing public good DAOs with AGI support.
22. Final DAM/DePIN R&D Report: Blog post of the comprehensive final research report detailing all findings, based on the R&D conducted throughout the project.
23. Comprehensive Project Documentation & Case Studies: Public release of a detailed knowledge base (e.g., GitBook, dedicated website) containing all process documentation, partner case studies (IME DAO, ChileDAO, Confederation and other Cardano Communities), technical specifications, user guides, ethical guidelines (esp. for AI/licensed content), and lessons learned.
24. Final Viral Content Package: Release of Framework launch videos, IME Fest showcase highlights reel, Open Program promotional materials, final R&D summary videos, and comprehensive case study summaries.

25. Ongoing Deliverables (Throughout Q3 2025 - Q2 2026):
25.1. Iterative refinement of the AGI Agent and AGI Avatar Phygital Interface based on continuous partner feedback and testing.
25.2. Continuous documentation of all processes, challenges, decisions, and learnings.
25.3. Active community building and engagement for the Planetary Public Good Network.

attributes.problem_statement:
This proposal directly confronts a critical constellation of interconnected problems hindering the realization of Cardano's potential as a global platform for decentralized collaboration, governance, and real-world impact. Despite the promise of Decentralized Autonomous Organizations (DAOs), their widespread adoption and effectiveness are significantly hampered by fundamental challenges:

1. Prohibitive DAO Complexity & Usability Barriers: Launching, managing, and participating effectively in DAOs remains excessively complex for the vast majority of potential users and organizations.

1.1. Steep Learning Curve: Onboarding requires significant technical literacy and time investment to understand governance mechanics, token interactions, and platform tools. This was a key challenge identified in Cooperativa Local's 2024 Cardano DAO Incubator, limiting participation primarily to technically adept individuals.

1.2. Operational Inefficiency: DAOs struggle with coordinating tasks, managing diverse communication channels (Discord, forums, etc.), tracking contributions fairly, and executing decisions efficiently without centralized overhead or sophisticated tooling.

1.3. Information Overload: As DAOs scale, members (and representatives like Cardano's DReps) face an overwhelming volume of proposals, discussions, and data, making informed participation and effective governance extremely difficult.

1.4. Unengaging Interfaces: Current DAO interaction primarily relies on functional but often unintuitive dashboards and text-based chat interfaces. These fail to capture the engagement of diverse users, especially those from creative or non-technical backgrounds, and lack the capacity for nuanced, context-aware interaction.

2. Ecosystem Fragmentation and Siloed Collaboration: The broader blockchain space, including Cardano's ecosystem, often operates in silos. National communities (like the diverse Web3 scene in Chile before ChileDAO's efforts) lack unified platforms for collaboration, leading to duplicated efforts and missed opportunities. This fragmentation extends globally, preventing synergistic development and knowledge sharing between regional hubs or different blockchain communities.

3. Difficulty Demonstrating Tangible Real-World Value: Communicating the practical benefits and transformative potential of blockchain and DAOs beyond niche Decentralized Finance (DeFi) applications remains a major hurdle. It is difficult to showcase compelling, relatable use cases that resonate with mainstream audiences, businesses, and traditional institutions, limiting broader adoption and understanding of Cardano's capabilities. Projects like IME DAO's ambitious decentralized festival face challenges in articulating their innovative model effectively.

4. The AI Integration Gap in Governance: While Artificial Intelligence (AI) holds immense potential to augment DAO capabilities, its integration into governance and operations is nascent and largely theoretical. There's a lack of:

4.1. Practical Frameworks: Methodologies for safely and effectively embedding AI into DAO decision-making loops are underdeveloped.

4.2. Tailored AI Tools: Generic AI models lack the specific contextual understanding of individual DAO goals, history, culture, and operational needs required for truly useful assistance.

4.3. Ethical Considerations: Frameworks for ensuring AI use in DAOs is transparent, accountable, and aligned with community values are missing.

5. Bridging Advanced Concepts (DAM/DePIN) to Practice: Cutting-edge concepts like Decentralized Autonomous Machines (DAMs) – AI-driven entities managing real-world assets via Internet of Things (IoT) and blockchain – and Decentralized Physical Infrastructure Networks (DePIN) offer powerful future possibilities. However, translating this academic research (like DOB Protocol's foundational paper) into practical applications within DAOs requires dedicated R&D, integration pathways, and real-world testbeds, which are currently scarce. DAOs lack the tools to easily interact with or govern RWA or DePIN infrastructure.

6. Funding & Sustainability Mismatch for Public Goods: Emerging DAOs focused on public goods, cultural initiatives (like IME DAO), or national ecosystem building (like ChileDAO) often lack substantial revenue streams. They require intensive, bespoke R&D support (e.g., for customized AI integration) that doesn't fit neatly into traditional venture capital or product-focused grant programs like Project Catalyst's recent partner challenges, creating a critical funding gap for foundational ecosystem development. Furthermore, sustainable operational models for such DAOs are needed beyond initial grants.

7. Scalability Challenges in Decentralized Governance (incl. Cardano's): As decentralized networks grow, ensuring effective, scalable governance becomes paramount. Cardano's own system, while pioneering, faces challenges related to DRep engagement, information processing for informed voting, and efficient coordination across committees and working groups. There is a need for innovative tools and potentially new models to support the Voltaire era's goals.

8. Regional Underrepresentation & Lack of Tailored Support: Key regions like Latin America and Africa, despite significant user interest and potential, remain underrepresented in Cardano governance metrics with less than 5% of de dRep voting power based on tenpo.vote reports / and may lack ecosystem support initiatives tailored to their specific cultural, linguistic, and economic contexts.

In essence, this proposal seeks to address the critical gap between the immense theoretical potential of AI-enhanced DAOs on Cardano for managing public goods, RWA, and complex systems, and the practical realities of usability, coordination, funding, and demonstrating value that currently limit their impact. We aim to solve these interconnected problems by building the foundational framework, intelligent tools (AGI Agent), engaging interfaces (AGI Avatar Phygital Interface), and validated, high-visibility use cases necessary to unlock this potential.

attributes.proposal_description:
1. Lead Entity & Vision: This proposal is presented by the Planetary Public Good Network, a pioneering consortium initiative dedicated to establishing Cardano as the secure, foundational infrastructure for a global network supporting the future of decentralized public goods. Our mission is to facilitate the creation, incubation, and acceleration of impactful public goods worldwide.

* We are building the Planetary Public Good DAO Framework – a synergistic integration of DAO operational methodology, advanced Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) Agents, and the interactive AGI Avatar Phygital Interface.
* This framework is envisioned as the ultimate and first Planetary Public Good delivered by this consortium, aiming to usher in a New Era of intelligent, effective, transparent, and sustainable decentralized organization, powered by real-time AGI insights derived from opt-in governance information provided transparently by participating DAOs (facilitated via DOB Protocol infrastructure). We strive for this framework to become the globally recognized benchmark for all DAOs seeking high performance and impact.

2. Founding Partners & Roles: The DAO launches with a powerhouse consortium of founding partners, each bringing unique expertise and serving as crucial testbeds, committed to collaborating on Cardano's DAO infrastructure (initially Clarity Protocol):

2.1. ChileDAO: ChileDAO: A vibrant, established national Web3 hub acting as a crucial bridge between diverse blockchain ecosystems (Cardano, Bitcoin, Ethereum, Chainlink, Avalanche, Stellar, Polkadot, Internet Computer (ICP), Mantle, Worldcoin, etc), academia and educational institutions, industry (Cámara Blockchain, FinteChile members), and a large community (>30 core members, >400 network). Committed to migrating its operations and onboarding representatives from its 30+ associated projects onto Cardano DAOs, ChileDAO serves as a complex, real-world testbed for AGI managing national-level coordination, ecosystem mapping, and acting as a rich talent pool for the consortium.

2.2. DOB Protocol: A cutting-edge research and development entity focused on the intersection of AI, blockchain, and real-world systems. With an operational Decentralized Physical Infrastructure Network (DePIN) financing platform in Chile and Peru, and published, peer-reviewed research on Decentralized Autonomous Machines (DAMs) (arXiv:2504.15676, IEEE ICBC 2025), DOB Protocol leads the R&D for the consortium's AGI Agent (based on their DOBI agent) and spearheads explorations into applying DAM/DePIN concepts to enhance DAO capabilities for managing Governance Data, Real World Assets (RWA), DeFi Contracts, and critical infrastructure on Cardano.

2.3. Cooperativa Local: A Chilean organization with deep expertise (since 2021) in Web3 adoption, community building within the cultural and creative sectors (backed by Start-Up Chile, Catalyst), and specifically in Cardano DAO incubation/acceleration (proven F11 program). Cooperativa Local provides the essential onboarding framework for all partners onto Cardano DAO platforms, manages the consortium's operations, coordinates the AGI Avatar Phygital Interface Focus Group, manages creative asset licensing, and runs the Planetary Public Good DAO's Public Program for global outreach.

2.4. Cardano Confederation and/or other groups active on governance: promoting principle-based networks comprising experienced of Cardano Community Members and Delegated Representatives (DReps) and active governance participants such as Intersect working groups or Community Hubs. Facilitating governance actions with ethics and transparency, the Confederation and other communities such as Intersect Hubs will provide invaluable insights to our focused on AGI Cardano's governance needs, serving as a pilot group for testing AGI tools designed to enhance DRep efficiency and members' governance (e.g., proposal summarization, sentiment analysis), and ensures the consortium's outputs remain aligned with Cardano's core values and community interests.

2.5. IME DAO: A unique Decentralized Autonomous Organization formed by Chile's union of electronic music workers (~200 members, ~60 active on Cardano/Clarity). Incubated and Accelerated by Cooperativa Local, IME DAO demonstrates the practical application of DAOs in the complex cultural sector by producing Chile's first decentralized music and technology festival, IME Link (June 21-22, 2025, Santiago de Chile). This provides a high-visibility, mass-audience showcase for the AGI Agent and the AGI Avatar Phygital Interface in action.

3. Core Public Good Deliverables: This proposal focuses the consortium's initial efforts on the intensive R&D, refinement, and launch of three core, interconnected Planetary Public Goods:

3.1. The Planetary Public Good DAO Framework (Ultimate & First Public Good): The overarching methodology, best practices, governance templates, and operational models for creating and running effective, AI-enhanced public good DAOs.

3.2. The AGI Agent for DAOs (Second Public Good): The adaptable AI software layer providing contextual intelligence and operational support to DAOs.

3.3. The AGI Avatar Phygital Interface (Third Public Good): The novel, interactive, and sustainable visual front-end for engaging with the AGI Agent and the DAO ecosystem.

4. Multichain Vision, Cardano Core: The framework, AGI Agent support layer, and AGI Avatar Phygital Interface are designed with multichain compatibility in mind (licensable), enabling broad adoption. However, the core Planetary Public Good DAO infrastructure, critical governance data security, core AGI processing logic, and primary value anchoring will remain based on Cardano, leveraging its unparalleled security, research foundation, and governance capabilities.

5. Eligibility & Gov Alignment: This initiative's scale, strategic R&D focus (AGI, DAM, DePIN), ecosystem-building scope, and alignment with Voltaire make it fundamentally suited for the Cardano Budget Process. It addresses needs unmet by Project Catalyst, particularly the lack of suitable funding mechanisms for intensive, tailored R&D support for emerging public good DAOs without large pre-existing revenues.

6. Budget & Treasury: Estimated cost: $370,000 USD (731,080 ADA) @ $0.5061 USD/ADA (S3 Support-3 based on Tradingview technical report of April-24). Funds will be managed with full transparency in the Planetary Public Good DAO's Treasury (Clarity Protocol), including publicly published monthly expenditure reports. Responsible spending is a core principle.
